# Amera Technologies

Amera Technologies builds certificate-free machine identity and deterministic key governance infrastructure for OT, IT, and classified networks. Our products eliminate internal PKI complexity, stop silent certificate expiry, and deliver hardware-rooted identity at scale — with no cloud dependency.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://amera.io/
- AmeraKey (machine identity & key governance): https://amera.io/products/amerakey
- AmeraSecrets (vault-free secrets management): https://amera.io/products/amerasecrets
